sentimento.text1: The presidential book has accumulated USD 132.34M and the prices on this page come from the confirmed reading of Aug 24, 6:25 PM BRT (9:25 PM UTC). Lula is at 62.50% (vol USD 8.92M) and Flávio Bolsonaro at 35.05% (vol USD 8.84M), with 27.45pp between them.
sentimento.text2: The day had movement, and it came from one side only. Lula ended with no change at all and Flávio Bolsonaro rose 1.80pp, the largest gain in the book on the day. The distance between the two fell from 29.25pp to 27.45pp, and the entire compression comes from the second-place gain. Renan Santos gave up 0.55pp and stands at 2.90%.
sentimento.text3: Two superlatives apply today, both dated against the series that begins on Apr 14: the 35.05% for Flávio Bolsonaro is his highest reading since May 13, and the 27.45pp gap is the narrowest since Jun 21 on the daily-close criterion. ⚠️ Neither is a series extreme: his peak is 45.50%, from May 6, and on May 5 the gap was actually NEGATIVE by 7.80pp, with him ahead. Lula's highest reading since Apr 14 is 67.50%, from Aug 16.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 35.05% in the presidential contract, up 1.80pp, and 85.50% in the first-round runner-up contract, down 1.00pp. The Liberal Party has 77.50% in the market for the largest Senate caucus.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 62.50%, unchanged on the day. In the first-round runner-up contract he appears with 5.95%, which is consistent with a market that sees him finishing first.
sentimento.terceiraVia: Renan Santos at 2.90% after giving up 0.55pp, and Ronaldo Caiado at 0.70% after gaining 0.15pp. In the first-round third-place contract the two remain 15.00pp apart, at 54.00% against 39.00%, and both gave up 2.00pp on the day.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of Aug 24, 6:25 PM BRT (9:25 PM UTC). AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp. ⚠️ The lock proves the price is not in transit; it does not prove it is the level of the day.

inss.text1: ⭐ NEW FACT ON Aug 24, and it is about public policy, not investigation. The government is considering applying a differentiated adjustment to INSS beneficiaries, according to InfoMoney and Poder360, which attribute the information to newspaper reporting.
inss.text2: On the same day the institute began allowing payroll-loan contracting without biometrics, validated through banking data, and started blocking loans during the first 90 days of a benefit, according to the day's coverage. These are administrative measures, and the panel records them as management context, not as an outcome of the fraud case.
inss.text3: The distinction the panel has maintained from the start still holds: the effect on the evaluation of the administration is one thing, the effect on voting intention is another. ⛔ The panel does NOT attribute the narrowing of the price gap to this case, because no measurement isolates that effect.
inss.text4: ⚠️ The case remains live in the courts and without resolution: coverage on Aug 24 records that an investigation into drug-trafficking money laundering reached the Supreme Court over a possible link to the Master and INSS cases. An allegation under investigation is not a proven fact, and the panel records it as an allegation.
inss.impactoLula: Not isolable. BTG/Nexus on Aug 24 puts him at 41% in the first round and ahead in the runoff by 46% to 45%, and in that same wave he is the most rejected candidate, at 49%. ⛔ No poll in the window isolates the effect of the case on those numbers, and the panel does not estimate it.
inss.impactoGestao: The evaluation still carries a negative balance and it widened: 43% rate the administration poor or terrible against 35% excellent or good in BTG/Nexus on Aug 24, a gap of 8 points, against 42% and 34% in the same house's Aug 17 wave. Approval and disapproval stand at 48% and 49%. The panel records the balance and does not project an electoral effect from it.
inss.conclusao: The case remains without judicial resolution. What the week adds is of another nature: administrative measures by the institute and a discussion of benefit adjustment, which touch management and not the investigation. The panel keeps the two separate.

bancoMaster.text1: ⭐ THE NEW FACT ON Aug 24 IS CORPORATE. At an extraordinary general meeting, BRB shareholders approved by majority the adoption of civil liability measures against former administrators identified as responsible for damages to the bank in operations of the Master and Reag ecosystem, according to Metrópoles and CNN Brasil.
bancoMaster.text2: ⚠️ THE CAVEAT IS IN THE ACT ITSELF, and it matters: the authorisation is granted under article 159 of Law 6,404/1976 and does NOT represent a prior determination of anyone's liability. It is a corporate procedure that enables the bank to sue, not a conviction.
bancoMaster.text3: The panel keeps the two things separate on purpose. A shareholder authorisation is a corporate-governance step, the criminal investigation runs on another track, and the case remains without judicial resolution. No contract on the panel prices this case directly, so there is no price to cite here.
bancoMaster.conclusao: On Aug 24 the case advances through a shareholder procedure, not through an investigative act nor a ruling on the merits. The day's coverage also records that developments in the Master and Lulinha cases continue to feed both campaigns, with outcomes the press itself projects for after the election.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act captured on Aug 24.
stf.moraes: He appears in coverage on Aug 24, not in a new act: a congressman asked him to investigate an ally of the Bolsonaro family arrested in Bolivia, according to the day's collection. A filed request is not a ruling.
stf.gilmar: No new individual act on Aug 24.
stf.dino: ⭐ THE RELEVANT ACT IS STILL HIS, and it gained detail on Aug 23. Flávio Dino reaffirmed that the designation of parliamentary amendments by party presidents, former congressmen or people without a mandate is null, citing suspicions about the president of the PL and a former congressman, and set a non-extendable deadline of five business days for parties that have not yet responded, under a daily fine of R$ 100 thousand, according to Poder360 and CNN Brasil. On Aug 24 he also authorised the Federal Police to access evidence held by the São Paulo state police about the producer of the film Dark Horse.
stf.mendonca: He appears in coverage on Aug 24, not in a new act: the day's collection records that developments in the Master and Lulinha cases widened divergences between him and the prosecutor general.
stf.nexo: ⭐ THE LINK REMAINS BUDGETARY, not electoral. The amendments ruling reaches the machinery that funds a congressional base in an election year, and it now names the leadership of the party of the second-placed candidate in the price. ⛔ The panel records the reach of the ruling and does NOT attribute the day's price movement to it: no measurement connects the two.
stf.analise: The contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 stands at 3.35% (vol USD 84 thousand), unchanged from yesterday, in the confirmed reading of Aug 24, 6:25 PM BRT (9:25 PM UTC). The market did not move either on Dino's amendments ruling of Aug 23 or on the São Paulo electoral court ruling on Pablo Marçal of Aug 24. An institutional contract holding still on a day when the presidential book moved 1.80pp on one side.
